messages:
alex_t: heads up — deploy-bot aborted publishing the staging image for service-api. error mentions missing provenance annotation (ECR).
deploy-bot: publish aborted: provenance-annotation-check failed for image sha256:abcdef123456... KMS timestamp write error.
maria_s: when did this start? is canary impacted?
alex_t: noticed during the nightly batch push at 01:12 UTC. only us-west-2 staging mirror affected so far. canary was scheduled but not rolled.
jamie: quick logs show cosign returned a 504 while attaching timestamp. snippet:

```
ERROR cosign: HTTP 504 from kms.example.internal/v1/timestamp - write timeout
```

paul_r: sounds like a transient KMS issue. safe path: pin canary to previous digest (sha256:1234abcd...) and retag+republish a fresh build after attestation succeeds.
anita: agree with pin. also we should add a line to release notes: "staging publish skipped due to attestation timeout; canary pinned to previous digest during change window." keeps product informed.
maria_s: can we force a publish with a fallback signing key? security usually rejects fallbacks for production; staging maybe allowed but need approval.
sre_oncall: prefer retag & republish instead of fallback. propose: hold canary for a 30m change window, pin it, then manual approve republish once KMS responds.
alex_t: action items: 1) pin canary to sha256:1234abcd (paul_r) 2) hold canary (jamie) 3) retry publish after KMS TTL refresh / cosign restart (maria_s) 4) update release notes + changelog (anita).
paul_r: started pinning now — updating deploy config.
jamie: canary route paused in console, leaving a note: route=staging-canary paused :warning:
anita: added a release note draft and pinged product for visibility.
maria_s: will restart the cosign client and re-run the publish in ~10m, will post results here.
deploy-bot: retry publish initiated by maria_s. publish succeeded: new image sha256:fedcba654321 with attestation attached. provenance check OK.
alex_t: closing the loop: we pinned the canary for the change window, republished with a fresh attestation, and updated release notes. follow-up: add KMS retry/backoff to cosign client and add metric alert for cosign timestamp failures.
paul_r: filing a quick 🔧 ticket for cosign backoff and an alert rule for timestamp errors.
